faq1.question: Is this YouTube Downloader available worldwide?
faq1.answer: Yes, our YouTube Downloader is accessible globally and works in all regions where YouTube is available. As a free online tool, it doesn't have geographic restrictions, allowing users from around the world to download YouTube videos without watermark.

faq2.question: Where are the downloaded videos saved?
faq2.answer: For iOS users: Videos are saved to the 'Files' app by default, from where you can easily transfer them to your camera roll. For Android users: Videos are typically saved to the 'Downloads' folder and can be accessed through your device's gallery or file manager. On computers, you can choose the save location during download.

faq3.question: Can I download YouTube thumbnails or cover images?
faq3.answer: While our primary function is video downloading, you can extract YouTube thumbnails by modifying the video URL. However, our tool focuses on providing high-quality video downloads without watermark. For cover images, you can right-click and save the thumbnail image directly from YouTube.

faq4.question: Will the original creator know I downloaded their video?
faq4.answer: No, downloading videos through our tool is completely private and anonymous. We don't track or report download activities to YouTube or content creators. The download process happens through our edge nodes without contacting the original creator, ensuring your privacy and leaving no trace.

faq5.question: Why does the tool sometimes fail to parse links?
faq5.answer: Parsing may fail for several reasons: the video might be set to private or unlisted by the creator, the YouTube URL could be expired or malformed, regional restrictions may apply, or the video might have been removed. Only publicly accessible YouTube videos can be processed by our tool.
